title: How do you think? (Roguelike action)
author: GrungEndure
selftext: Wish to get any of the feedback overall

comments.author: counterclockwisdom
comments.body: There’s no clear hook / fun part. What makes this game fun? Why would I want to play it? The video makes it look like a Vampire Survivors clone with no standout qualities. It looks choppy, narrow, and cluttered. The characters also look generic but I may not be the target audience.

replies.author: GrungEndure
replies.body: Honestly ‘What makes this game fun?’ is the core question which I’m always questioning too.. Didn’t capture here but I added several sub-content inside the stage (such as enduring several time in boundary / rescue someone or such) to be not bored from non-stop action.. but other than that, i’m still thinking.. anyway thanks for the comment

replies.author: counterclockwisdom
replies.body: Be careful about trying to solve the “fun” question by adding more content. Sometimes, there is a minimum amount of content for you to get the experience you desire, and adding content is justified, but “adding more content” often turns into a crutch that never actually makes the game more fun to play. The basic gameplay itself needs to be fun, too! Hone the core experience you want your players to enjoy.

replies.author: GrungEndure
replies.body: noted. Thanks for the opinion anyway :) i will think more about the core fun
